candidate.claim: combineURLs strips trailing slashes from baseURL and leading slashes from relativeURL then concatenates without inserting '/', producing e.g. 'http://a/b'+'c' as 'http://a/bc' instead of 'http://a/b/c'.
candidate.title: combineURLs missing '/' separator

verifier.reason: The code at helpers/combineURLs.js:22 returns baseURL.slice(0, end) concatenated directly with relativeURL stripped of leading slashes, with no '/' inserted, so 'http://a/b' + 'c' yields 'http://a/bc'.

candidate.claim: buildURL keeps the '#' when stripping the fragment (slice to hashmarkIndex+1), so serialized params are appended after '#' inside the fragment instead of as a query string.
candidate.title: buildURL appends query after '#' fragment

verifier.reason: The code at helpers/buildURL.js:63 uses url.slice(0, hashmarkIndex + 1), retaining the '#', and helpers/buildURL.js:65 then appends '?'+serializedParams after it, placing the params inside the fragment.

candidate.claim: createScheduler.start overwrites this.timer with a new setInterval without clearing an existing interval, leaking the previous timer handle.
candidate.title: scheduler start replaces timer without clearing

verifier.reason: helpers/scheduler.js:7 assigns this.timer = setInterval(callback, intervalMs) with no preceding clearInterval, and helpers/scheduler.js:10 in stop() is the only clearing path, so calling start twice loses the previous timer handle.
